in_sanskrit.name: चन्द्रवक

in_marathi.name: Candravaka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Candravaka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Candra' meaning moon and 'vaka' meaning one who observes or watches. In Hindu mythology, the name Candravaka is associated with the Moon God and those who are believed to observe and protect the lunar cycles.

in_bengali.name: Candravaka

In Hindu mythology, the name Candravaka is associated with the Moon God and those who are believed to observe and protect the lunar cycles.
